title: Default wiki export configuration during marker generation
body: When MCP Server writes a workspace marker file, it must also create a default docs/wiki.yaml if the workspace does not already provide one, so wiki export has an explicit document tree for future GitHub and Azure exports.
notes: PLAN-WIKIEXPORT-001 follow-up. Existing docs/wiki.yaml files are authoritative and must not be overwritten.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Marker generation creates docs/wiki.yaml under the workspace root when that file is absent.
Marker generation leaves an existing docs/wiki.yaml byte-for-byte unchanged.
The default wiki.yaml uses schema mcp-wiki-export/v1 and declares a complete flattened document list for generated home, functional, technical, testing, mapping, and matrix documents.
The default navigation tree references every declared document exactly once and is valid for both GitHub and Azure wiki export.
The generated default config is written through object serialization, not line-based YAML construction.
